Package com.blindpath.domain.labyrinth

Class Obstacle

java.lang.Object
com.blindpath.domain.labyrinth.Obstacle
All Implemented Interfaces:
Collidable
Direct Known Subclasses:
Wall
public abstract class Obstacle extends Object implements Collidable
Obstacle rectangulaire du labyrinthe. Il bloque les collisions, sauf s'il est désactivé.
